KCM (Keeping Current Matters) is a content membership for real estate agents. Starting at $59.95/month, you get access to pre-written blog posts, social graphics, and national market data branded with your logo. KCM creates the same content for every member — their own FAQ confirms it. The platform auto-posts to Facebook, LinkedIn, and Twitter, but does not post to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, or Google Business Profile. Video is limited to a teleprompter tool on the highest-priced plan.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The core question: do you want generic national content that every other agent shares, or original content designed for your brand and your market? Here is how they compare.
KCM’s FAQ confirms their shareable content is the same for all members. Agents in overlapping markets post identical graphics and blog posts.
VEXI creates original custom local graphics for your brand.
KCM content relies on national housing statistics. What is happening nationally can be very different from your local market.
VEXI creates content specific to your area.

Does KCM create custom local content for my market?

Partially. KCM provides national market data and blog posts that are the same for all members. Their KCM Local feature adds zip-code-level stats, but the graphics, videos, and blog content are shared templates — not custom-designed for your brand. VEXI creates original custom local graphics and captions tailored to your market, brand, and audience.
Does KCM include professional video editing?

KCM’s Elite plan ($99.95/month) includes RealTalk, a teleprompter and video recording tool with pre-written scripts. But there is no professional video editing — you record yourself reading a script and the video is auto-formatted. VEXI includes professional short-form video editing on every plan.
Does KCM post to all social media platforms?
KCM offers automated posting to Facebook, LinkedIn, and Twitter only. There is no native posting to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, or Google Business Profile.
Is KCM content unique to me or shared with other agents?

KCM’s own FAQ states that some shareable content is the same for all members. Blog posts, social graphics, and video scripts are standardized templates branded with your logo and colors — but agents in overlapping markets may share identical content. VEXI creates original custom local graphics designed specifically for each client’s brand and market.
